messages:
Alex P: FYI we just hit a procurement snag on RidgeWave's marketplace PO (PO# RW-2026-0599). Commercial signed, procurement is holding because of redlines to indemnity and IP. Need a quick escalation.

Maria D: Seen it. They want a mutual IP clause and unlimited indemnity for third-party patents. Legal already shot down unlimited.

Jordan S: Timeline is tight  RidgeWave has a co-launch scheduled Friday and marketing is waiting on the marketplace tile to go live. Can we do a stopgap?

Nisha L: Looked through their edits. Two sticking points: 1) IP transfer language that would grant them rights to our model outputs, and 2) punitive indemnity for downstream claims. Proposed compromise below.
```
We keep vendor ownership of pre-existing and platform IP. Customer gets a limited license for marketplace listing and customer-facing docs. Liability cap = total fees paid in prior 12 months. For pilot period (first 60 days) cap = committed spend and 20% holdback applies.
```

Tom R: Finance can accept the 12-month fees cap if Sales confirms committed ARR and invoicing plan. Also need to know whether we accept their PO as the primary contract or require our MSA + PO. Their procurement insists PO-only.

Alex P: Sales confirmed expected ARR = $285k year one. We can accept PO-only if we can append a short addendum rather than renegotiating the full MSA. That will speed things up.

Maria D: Could we ask for a "conditional PO" that references our addendum and includes a payment holdback until legal signs the addendum? Marketing will proceed to build the tile if the conditional PO is in place.

Nisha L: Conditional PO + holdback is possible. I'll draft an addendum that: (a) preserves our IP language, (b) limits liability during pilot to committed spend, (c) sets out a 20% final payment hold until full agreement signed. Will post in ~25m.

Jordan S: I'll loop in RidgeWave procurement (cc: @rprocure). If we get the conditional PO with explicit holdback wording, they said they'd sign immediately.

ProcureBot: PO RW-2026-0599 status updated to "Review Requested" by Maria D at 2026-04-13 15:12 UTC.

Tom R: Reminder: for accounting automation we need exact invoice milestones. Jordan, can you confirm delivery milestones for invoicing?

Jordan S: Milestones: 2026-04-22 marketplace tile live = 50%, 2026-05-22 connector batch completed = 30%, 2026-06-22 final production acceptance = 20%. I'll email the schedule to Tom and attach to the PO.

Maria D: Once Nisha drops the draft, I'll send it legal-to-legal and ask RidgeWave to sign the conditional PO referencing our addendum. Goal: signed by EOD to avoid delaying launch. :pray: 

Nisha L: Draft uploaded to the deal folder and pasted here. TL;DR: keep platform IP, limited license to customer, 12-month fees liability cap, 20% holdback during pilot. If RidgeWave pushes more, escalate to VP Legal.

Alex P: Thanks team. I'm pinging RidgeWave procurement now and marking as high priority. If we don't have a signed conditional PO + addendum by EOD, escalate to Partnerships lead + Sales Ops.

ProcureBot: Outstanding items: signed conditional PO, signed addendum. Due by 2026-04-13 23:59 UTC.

Jordan S: Sent the conditional PO template and invoice milestones to their procurement contact. Waiting for reply.

Maria D: Keep all replies here. If RidgeWave attaches tracking notes or insists on new language, copy/paste so Legal sees it in context.

Nisha L: Will watch. If they accept the holdback we should be clear on release conditions (final signed addendum + acceptance test). I'll draft an acceptance clause too.

Alex P: Appreciate this. Co-launch Friday depends on it. :rocket:
